title: Evening Snowshoeing / Cross-country skiing Experience
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Booster seat for children available - please contact us beforehand
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Canadian Outdoor activities such as snowshoeing or cross-country skiing. 
You will spend an evening following the legacy of the 2010 Vancouver and Whistler Winter Olympics - and get active yourself!
Explore the Olympic Park, and enjoy a breathtaking scenery of the Callaghan valley winter wonderland.
Admission and rental of either snowshoes or cross-country ski sets are included, as well as a dinner with soup/stew of the day and a hot chocolate.
